recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. If special URL behavior needs further maintenance, update the IG Publisher/tools package and only change core if a current core resource or narrative becomes misleading.
issue_request: FHIR-13131 asked the IG Publisher to allow intentionally configured ValueSet definitions whose canonical URLs are external to the IG canonical URL pattern, so existing value set URIs do not have to be reassigned when included in an IG.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 11838. The corresponding git-svn commit, 28a392498d760100b188b72e49c05ee2958e7c84, added a special-urls configuration list and an isListedURLExemption check to the then in-tree IG Publisher URL-mismatch validation.
additional_context: The in-tree IG Publisher was removed from this repository in 2019 because it moved to Maven. Current FHIR core source treats ImplementationGuide.definition.parameter as tool-defined with an extensible binding, and ValueSet.url no longer has any IG-canonical-pattern restriction. The current hl7.fhir.uv.tools package defines special-url and special-url-base in http://hl7.org/fhir/tools/CodeSystem/ig-parameters.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source files were changed. The surviving authoritative behavior and parameter definitions are external to this core checkout, so this result records an external-repo audit decision.
